sql: SELECT pm.match_id, pm.player_slot, pm.hero_id, pm.lane, pm.is_roaming, pm.gold_t[11] AS gold_10, pm.xp_t[11] AS xp_10, pm.lh_t[11] AS lh_10, m.radiant_win, m.start_time FROM player_matches pm JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT p.match_id FROM player_matches p JOIN match_patch mp USING (match_id) WHERE p.hero_id = 1 AND p.gold_t IS NOT NULL AND mp.patch = '7.41' ORDER BY p.match_id DESC LIMIT 300)
